Personality disorder without defined damage to a covered organ.

Inherited LDL metabolism disorder; coronary atherosclerosis is a separate disease. Corneal arcus does not impair ocular function.

Persistent severe neutrophil deficiency causes impaired antibacterial immunity; infection sites vary and do not establish additional organ damage.
Acute viral infection of the liver; constitutional symptoms and arthralgia do not establish extrahepatic damage.

Anthrax infection of the oropharynx; the pharynx belongs to the pulmonary axis. Intestinal involvement is not required.
Cerebral arterial aneurysm; seizures and hemiparesis each annotated at 30-79% support neurological involvement. Hemorrhage itself is only 5-29%.
Cholesteatoma occupies the epitympanic attic of the middle ear.
Neutropenic immunodeficiency; exocrine pancreatic insufficiency 2/3 and neurodevelopmental features including autistic behavior 2/2. Raised transaminases alone do not prove liver damage.
Skeletal dwarfism, nail dysplasia and hypotrichosis define SOFT syndrome; developmental delay reported in 2/5 (40%). Diabetes is occasional and separately diagnosed.
Inflammation confined to placental villi; placenta has no axis, and an infectious or autoimmune cause is not specified.
Skeletal dysplasia; myopia, hearing impairment and cleft palate each occur in 30-79%. Retinal detachment and cataract are occasional.
Onchocerca infection directly affects the eye; additional organ damage is not established for this ocular concept.
Benign neoplasm defined by vulvar reproductive-organ origin; no covered organ involvement is required across this umbrella.
Mesenchymal neoplasms arise in soft connective tissue or bone; no additional organ applies consistently across the umbrella.
Testicular germ-cell neoplasm of reproductive origin; no endocrine dysfunction or covered organ involvement is specified.
Skeletal malformations and auditory canal atresia with hearing loss define SAMS. Feeding difficulty and high palate do not establish GI damage; microcephaly alone lacks neural dysfunction.
Adenocarcinoma originates in ovarian reproductive epithelium; endocrine dysfunction and other organ occupation are not defining features.
Immune-mediated cutaneous granulomas; pulmonary sarcoid involvement occurs in roughly 50-70% of cutaneous cases, although isolated skin disease occurs.
